5092.title: Literal environment paths are saved without explaining expansion semantics
5092.rootCauseOneLine: The CLI and encrypted settings preserve strings verbatim; the daemon assigns them directly to child environments, while save-time guidance does not explain that shell path syntax remains literal.
5092.proposedFix: Preserve secret bytes and document literal interpretation at UI/CLI save boundaries; a complete repair exceeds the one-subsystem autopilot gate.
5092.caveats: The literal-value and missing-CLI-notice defect is reproduced end to end. Claude Code login and macOS desktop behavior were not exercised; directory creation uses a generic Node child, not a provider.
